large_file_detection.rationale: .github/workflows/post-release-automation.yml warns when the generated source tarball exceeds 8000 MB; this is an artifact-size guard, not a source-file limit.

tech_debt_tracking.rationale: TODO comments exist, but no debt scanner, issue-link enforcement, or documented technical-debt tracking system was found.

build_cmd_doc.rationale: README.md documents make, make build redis, prerequisites, optional build flags, and installation.

deps_pinned.rationale: Core dependencies are vendored; modules/modules.yaml pins bundled modules to v8.11.90; validator requirements use exact == versions.

vcs_cli_tools.rationale: gh auth status and glab auth status both returned command not found; no authenticated VCS CLI is available.

automated_pr_review.rationale: Skipped: gh/glab are unavailable, so automated review comments on recent PRs cannot be verified.

agentic_development.rationale: No agent configurations, agent CI invocations, or AI co-authorship were found. The available git history is shallow and contains only one commit.

fast_ci_feedback.rationale: Skipped: no authenticated gh/glab access to measure primary PR check durations.

build_performance_tracking.rationale: Skipped: no authenticated VCS CLI or build-duration monitoring was found. Incremental make and documented parallel builds alone do not establish tracking.

deployment_frequency.rationale: Skipped: no authenticated VCS CLI to inspect release frequency and deployment workflow runs.

single_command_setup.rationale: README.md documents a short core-only path: make build redis, then ./src/redis-server; dependencies are vendored and prerequisites are described.

feature_flag_infrastructure.rationale: Runtime tuning options exist, but no explicit feature-rollout flag system or feature-flag workflow was found.

release_notes_automation.rationale: utils/releasetools/changelog.tcl generates a versioned, dated changelog from git history.

progressive_rollout.rationale: Not applicable: this repository builds distributable Redis software, not managed deployment infrastructure.

rollback_automation.rationale: Not applicable: no production deployment infrastructure is maintained in this repository.

monorepo_tooling.rationale: Not applicable: one application was identified; bundled modules and vendored libraries are not separate applications.

version_drift_detection.rationale: Multiple dependency/build packages exist, but no cross-package version consistency validation was found. The module pin manifest alone does not detect drift.

release_automation.rationale: post-release-automation.yml builds source tarballs, computes checksums, and uploads GitHub release assets after a release is published.

dead_feature_flag_detection.rationale: Skipped: feature_flag_infrastructure failed; no flag lifecycle or stale-flag detector was found.

readme.rationale: Root README.md provides prerequisites, build, launch, redis-cli usage, and test instructions.

automated_doc_generation.rationale: utils/generate-module-api-doc.rb generates Markdown API reference documentation from src/module.c comments.

skills.rationale: No repository-local SKILL.md files or valid skills directories were found.

documentation_freshness.rationale: The required git-log check reports README.md and CONTRIBUTING.md on 2026-11-03, within 180 days. History is shallow, which limits attribution.

service_flow_documented.rationale: TLS.md documents client connections and server-to-server replication, cluster bus, MIGRATE, and Sentinel communication and trust boundaries.

agents_md_validation.rationale: Prerequisite failed: AGENTS.md is absent. The modules build-flow workflow validates other documentation, not AGENTS.md.

devcontainer.rationale: No .devcontainer/devcontainer.json exists. docker/Dockerfile.noble is a build image, not a devcontainer configuration.

env_template.rationale: README.md documents build environment variables including BUILD_TLS and MALLOC. The default local server needs no environment file.

local_services_setup.rationale: Not applicable: standalone Redis requires no external service; the test harness starts its own Redis instances.

devcontainer_runnable.rationale: Skipped: the devcontainer CLI is not installed.

runbooks_documented.rationale: No dedicated operational runbooks, incident playbooks, or specific external runbook pointers were found.

branch_protection.rationale: Skipped: gh/glab are unavailable; administrator access and branch protection cannot be verified.

secret_scanning.rationale: Skipped: no file-based secret scanner was found, and authenticated/admin access is unavailable for native scanning verification.

codeowners.rationale: No CODEOWNERS file exists at the root or under .github.

automated_security_review.rationale: CodeQL analyzes C/C++ on PRs and schedules; the Coverity workflow uploads analysis for readable security findings.

dependency_update_automation.rationale: .github/dependabot.yml configures weekly GitHub Actions dependency updates. Live PR activity could not be checked without gh/glab.

gitignore_comprehensive.rationale: Build artifacts and IDE files are ignored, but root .gitignore does not exclude .env files or .DS_Store.

privacy_compliance.rationale: Privacy-by-design infrastructure exists: redis.conf documents hide-user-data-from-log, with implemented redaction and PII-safe diagnostic suppression. This is not a legal compliance certification.

secrets_management.rationale: GitHub workflows obtain Coverity and Codecov credentials and release upload tokens through secrets references, not hardcoded values.

min_release_age.rationale: No explicit minimum dependency release age or waiting-period policy was found; a weekly Dependabot schedule is not an age gate.

issue_templates.rationale: .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE contains structured bug, crash, feature, question, and other templates.

issue_labeling_system.rationale: No repository-defined priority/type/area label taxonomy was found; issue templates leave labels empty. Live labels could not be verified.

backlog_health.rationale: Skipped: gh/glab are unavailable, so issue labeling, age, and recent activity cannot be measured.

pr_templates.rationale: No pull request template with description, testing, and context sections was found.

lint_config.rationale: CodeQL and Coverity static analysis are configured in GitHub workflows; CI also compiles with warnings treated as errors.

type_check.rationale: src/Makefile compiles C with GCC/Clang, providing static type checks; CI builds on multiple platforms.

formatter.rationale: No Redis-wide automated formatter configuration or formatting CI check was found. Vendored projects' documentation is not root application coverage.

pre_commit_hooks.rationale: No checked-in pre-commit configuration or quality-check Git hook setup was found.

strict_typing.rationale: Not applicable: C has no separate project-wide strict typing mode comparable to TypeScript strict or mypy strict; compiler evidence is counted under type_check.

naming_consistency.rationale: No explicit enforced naming rules or naming convention instructions were found in project contribution documentation.

cyclomatic_complexity.rationale: No configured complexity analyzer, threshold, or complexity monitoring was found.

dead_code_detection.rationale: src/Makefile enables -Wall/-W and CI adds -Werror, detecting unused static functions and variables within compiler coverage.

duplicate_code_detection.rationale: No configured copy-paste or duplicate-code detector was found.

code_modularization.rationale: The large C application has source modules, but no architecture tests or tooling enforcing internal module boundaries was found.

n_plus_one_detection.rationale: Not applicable: Redis is the database implementation, not an ORM-backed application issuing database queries.

heavy_dependency_detection.rationale: Not applicable: Redis is a native server/CLI application, not a frontend bundle.

unused_dependencies_detection.rationale: No CI or hook checks whether vendored or declared dependencies are unused.

unit_tests_exist.rationale: tests/unit contains Tcl unit tests, including tests/unit/type/string.tcl; C component tests also exist.

integration_tests_exist.rationale: tests/integration includes replication, persistence, failover, and other multi-instance integration tests.

unit_tests_runnable.rationale: Direct bounded command ./runtest --single unit/type/string --only "SET and GET an item" --clients 1 --timeout 10 (Execute timeout 30s) exited 1 with a harness timeout. No successful test execution; src/redis-server is absent.

test_performance_tracking.rationale: The harness prints per-unit durations and a timing summary; CI invokes it with --verbose, retaining timing in workflow logs.

flaky_test_detection.rationale: tests/support/test.tcl provides bounded assert_with_retry, used with three attempts in hash-field-expire tests.

test_coverage_thresholds.rationale: Coverage is uploaded, but codecov.yml marks both patch and project status informational. No minimum coverage gate was found.

test_naming_conventions.rationale: tests/test_helper.tcl explicitly discovers *.tcl test units under configured unit and integration directories.

test_isolation.rationale: The Tcl harness uses parallel clients, separate Redis subprocesses, allocated port ranges, and per-server temporary configurations.

interactive_qa_exists.rationale: README.md covers toolchain prerequisites, the core-only build and server launch, then redis-cli PING/PONG and SET/GET. The default local flow has no login gate.

interactive_qa_runnable.rationale: Attempted ./src/redis-server with loopback binding, port 0, and persistence disabled; it exited 127 because the binary is absent. No live interaction was demonstrated; no full build was performed during this static audit.

api_schema_docs.rationale: Not applicable to OpenAPI/GraphQL: Redis serves RESP rather than HTTP/GraphQL. Native command JSON and reply schemas exist; no OpenAPI/Swagger/GraphQL files were found.

database_schema.rationale: Not applicable: Redis is a schemaless database engine and has no separate application database/ORM schema to provision.

structured_logging.rationale: Logging is implemented inside src/server.c. No logging-library dependency or dedicated logger module meeting this criterion was found.

distributed_tracing.rationale: No distributed trace ID/request ID propagation or tracing integration was found; client IDs alone are not distributed tracing.

metrics_collection.rationale: INFO exports command throughput, memory, network, hit/miss, and latency metrics; native LATENCY histograms are implemented.

code_quality_metrics.rationale: The Codecov workflow generates lcov coverage and uploads it; Coverity provides scheduled static-analysis reporting.

error_tracking_contextualized.rationale: No Sentry, Bugsnag, Rollbar, or equivalent contextualized error-tracking integration was found.

alerting_configured.rationale: Sentinel supports notification hooks, but no enabled notification destination or operational alerting integration was found.

deployment_observability.rationale: No deployment-impact dashboard references or active deploy notifications were found; Slack notification code is commented out.

health_checks.rationale: The native PING command is explicitly documented as the server liveness response and returns PONG; CI uses it to await readiness.

circuit_breakers.rationale: Not applicable to the standalone target: no external service dependency is required. Peer failover and optional notification retries are native Redis/Sentinel behavior.

profiling_instrumentation.rationale: Native SLOWLOG and LATENCY instrumentation support performance investigation; src/debug.c implements a configurable watchdog that captures stack traces for stalls.

dast_scanning.rationale: Not applicable: Redis exposes RESP, not a deployed web application or HTTP service targeted by this criterion.

pii_handling.rationale: redis.conf explicitly documents avoiding PII in logs; hide-user-data-from-log redacts user data and suppresses sensitive stack/backlog diagnostics.

log_scrubbing.rationale: redactLogCstr and redactClientCommandArgument scrub sensitive values; CONFIG/ACL paths and diagnostic dumps use redaction mechanisms.

product_analytics_instrumentation.rationale: No product analytics integration was found. Redis operational command statistics do not establish end-user product analytics.

error_to_insight_pipeline.rationale: No production-error-to-issue automation or error-tracker issue integration was found.

..description: Redis database server and bundled CLI, Sentinel, benchmarking tools, and Redis extension modules.
